title: "The Economics of Programming Languages" by Evan Czaplicki (Strange Loop 2023)
summary: Evan Czaplicki, creator of Elm, examines how programming languages are funded. He looks at where compiler engineers' salaries come from, why Go has about 5 engineers while Dart has about 30, and how this limits language design.
why: Recommended repeatedly as a funny, informative talk on the economics behind programming languages and open source.

quote.text: Very highly recommend this funny, informative talk to understand aspects of creating a programming language other than the theoretical ones.
